description: This file defines a Fragment class for an Android application that demonstrates a sliding tabs UI component with customizable indicator and divider colors. It includes inner classes for representing individual tabs, manages a ViewPager for swiping between pages, and integrates with a custom SlidingTabLayout to display and style the tab strip.

classes.name: SlidingTabsColorsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that sets up a ViewPager with multiple tabs, each with customizable indicator and divider colors, using a custom SlidingTabLayout for display.

classes.name: SlidingTabsColorsFragment.SamplePagerItem
classes.description: An inner class representing individual tab items with title, indicator color, and divider color; provides method to create content fragments.

classes.name: SlidingTabsColorsFragment.SampleFragmentPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing fragments within the ViewPager, providing titles and fragments for each tab.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes tab data with titles and colors.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager and SlidingTabLayout, including tab color customization.
